records.text: News Group Newspapers published an allegation that Susan Hamblin procured a 16-year-old for Jeffrey Epstein, then removed the articles and paid her substantial compensation.
records.speaker: James Li

appearances.snippet: Susan Hamblin sued News Group newspapers, the publisher of The Sun, who had printed that Susan Hamblin had groomed and procured a 16-year-old woman to be sexually abused by Epstein and told her that Epstein would kill her and her family if she told anyone what Epstein had done. They've since removed those articles and agreed to pay her a substantial compensation.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. A High Court statement records that News Group Newspapers accepted allegations about Susan Hamblin were false, removed the articles, apologized, and agreed to pay substantial compensation and costs.

sources.title: Susan Hamblin v News Group Newspapers: Statement in Open Court
sources.relevance: Primary court statement confirming falsity, removal, apology, and compensation.
